reserveReview.rationale: The original 2026-10-01 composition is preserved. Liquidity metadata reviewed at Sonic block 80306692 on 2026-10-03: actual frxUSD balanceOf(custodian), totalAssets() and native USSD totalSupply() all equal 970845213627100913413464 base units. The beacon returns implementation 0xd2478f5db285e7d4f1a260c9f142168124d02370. Its verified full source burns caller-owned USSD and transfers idle frxUSD atomically; isolatedBackingEnabled=false, router=0, individualCustodian=0, redeemFee=0. Immediate describes availability of the entire direct frxUSD position under the local withdrawal mechanism, not sale at a guaranteed USD price or final bank settlement. Owner recovery, isolation activation, token freeze and upgrade powers remain separate adverse controls; parent reserves and fiat redemption remain inherited.
